answer: Identity bonds decay unless renewed by honest work. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond locked 20 epochs, a marble record. Verified deliveries slow the decay; silence flakes the bond away like shale. A fake re-posts 40 credits when its bond dies: 100 fakes burn 4,000 credits against 120 per epoch, a 33-epoch payback, while renewals dry like a river in drought. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond alive by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
